title: Quantum phase transition in superconducting Au0.7In0.3 films of very low normal-state sheet resistance
abstract: We report the observation of a quantum phase transition (QPT), tuned by a parallel magnetic field, between a superconducting and metallic state in Au0.7In0.3 films of very low normal-state sheet resistance (< 90 Ohms). These films can be modeled as a random array of superconductor-normal metal-superconductor (SNS) junctions. Electrical transport and tunneling measurements suggest that, in the metallic state, the film consists of superconducting In-rich grains not linked by Josephson coupling. Whether phase fluctuation, which is not expected to be strong in such an SNS junction system according to the phase-number uncertainty relation, or a different physical process drives the observed QPT is discussed.
